verses.original: Καὶ διαγενομένου τοῦ σαββάτου Μαρία ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ καὶ Μαρία ἡ τοῦ Ἰακώβου καὶ Σαλώμη ἠγόρασαν ἀρώματα ἵνα ἐλθοῦσαι ἀλείψωσιν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Kai diagenomenou tou sabbatou Maria hē Magdalēnē kai Maria hē tou Iakōbou kai Salōmē ēgorasan arōmata hina elthousai aleipsōsin auton
verses.literal: When the Sabbath was over Mary Magdalene Mary the mother of James and Salome bought spices so they could go and anoint the body of Jesus
verses.literalPt: Passado o sábado, Maria Madalena, Maria, mãe de Tiago, e Salomé compraram aromas para ir embalsamá-lo.

verses.original: καὶ λίαν πρωῒ τῇ μιᾷ τῶν σαββάτων ἔρχονται ἐπὶ τὸ μνημεῖον ἀνατείλαντος τοῦ ἡλίου
verses.transliteration: kai lian prōi tē mia tōn sabbatōn erchontai epi to mnēmeion anateilantos tou hēliou
verses.literal: Very early on the first day of the week just after sunrise . . . they went to the tomb
verses.literalPt: Muito cedo, no primeiro dia da semana, foram ao túmulo, tendo já saído o sol.

verses.original: καὶ ἔλεγον πρὸς ἑαυτάς Τίς ἀποκυλίσει ἡμῖν τὸν λίθον ἐκ τῆς θύρας τοῦ μνημείου
verses.transliteration: kai elegon pros heautas Tis apokylisei hēmin ton lithon ek tēs thyras tou mnēmeiou
verses.literal: They were asking one another Who will roll away the stone from the entrance of the tomb
verses.literalPt: Diziam entre si: Quem nos há de remover a pedra da entrada do túmulo?

verses.original: καὶ ἀναβλέψασαι θεωροῦσιν ὅτι ἀποκεκύλισται ὁ λίθος ἦν γὰρ μέγας σφόδρα
verses.transliteration: kai anablepsasai theōrousin hoti apokekylistai ho lithos ēn gar megas sphodra
verses.literal: But when they looked up they saw that the stone had been rolled away even though it was extremely large
verses.literalPt: Olhando, notaram que a pedra já estava removida; pois era muito grande.

verses.original: Καὶ εἰσελθοῦσαι εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον εἶδον νεανίσκον καθήμενον ἐν τοῖς δεξιοῖς περιβεβλημένον στολὴν λευκήν καὶ ἐξεθαμβήθησαν
verses.transliteration: Kai eiselthousai eis to mnēmeion eidon neaniskon kathēmenon en tois dexiois peribeblēmenon stolēn leukēn kai exethambēthēsan
verses.literal: When they entered . . . the tomb they saw a young man dressed in a white robe sitting on the right side and they were alarmed
verses.literalPt: Entrando no túmulo, viram um moço sentado ao lado direito, vestido de um alvo manto, e ficaram atemorizadas.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ λέγει αὐταῖς Μὴ ἐκθαμβεῖσθε Ἰησοῦν ζητεῖτε τὸν Ναζαρηνὸν τὸν ἐσταυρωμένον ἠγέρθη οὐκ ἔστιν ὧδε ἴδε ὁ τόπος ὅπου ἔθηκαν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: ho de legei autais Mē ekthambeisthe Iēsoun zēteite ton Nazarēnon ton estaurōmenon ēgerthē ouk estin hōde ide ho topos hopou ethēkan auton
verses.literal: But he said to them Do not be alarmed You are looking for Jesus the Nazarene who was crucified He has risen He is not here See the place where they put Him
verses.literalPt: Ele lhes disse: Não vos atemorizeis; buscais a Jesus, o Nazareno, que foi crucificado; ele ressurgiu, não está aqui; vede o lugar onde o puseram.

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ὑπάγετε εἴπατε τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ τῷ Πέτρῳ ὅτι Προάγει ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν ἐκεῖ αὐτὸν ὄψεσθε καθὼς εἶπεν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: alla hypagete eipate tois mathētais autou kai tō Petrō hoti Proagei hymas eis tēn Galilaian ekei auton opsesthe kathōs eipen hymin
verses.literal: But go tell His disciples and Peter He is going ahead of you into Galilee There you will see Him just as He told you
verses.literalPt: Mas ide dizer a seus discípulos e a Pedro que ele vai adiante de vós para a Galileia; lá o vereis, como ele vos disse.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐξελθοῦσαι ἔφυγον ἀπὸ τοῦ μνημείου εἶχεν γὰρ αὐτὰς τρόμος καὶ ἔκστασις καὶ οὐδενὶ οὐδὲν εἶπαν ἐφοβοῦντο γάρ
verses.transliteration: Kai exelthousai ephygon apo tou mnēmeiou eichen gar autas tromos kai ekstasis kai oudeni ouden eipan ephobounto gar
verses.literal: So the women left . . . the tomb and ran away trembling and bewildered And in their fear they did not say . . . a word to anyone
verses.literalPt: Saindo, fugiram do túmulo, porque o temor e espanto as tinham acometido; não disseram nada a ninguém, porque estavam possuídas de medo.

verses.original: Ἀναστὰς δὲ πρωῒ πρώτῃ σαββάτου ἐφάνη πρῶτον Μαρίᾳ τῇ Μαγδαληνῇ παρ’ ἧς ἐκβεβλήκει ἑπτὰ δαιμόνια
verses.transliteration: Anastas de prōi prōtē sabbatou ephanē prōton Maria tē Magdalēnē par’ hēs ekbeblēkei hepta daimonia
verses.literal: Early on the first day of the week after Jesus had risen He appeared first to Mary Magdalene from whom He had driven out seven demons
verses.literalPt: [Havendo ele ressuscitado de manhã cedo no primeiro dia da semana, apareceu primeiramente a Maria Madalena, da qual havia expelido sete demônios.

verses.original: ἐκείνη πορευθεῖσα ἀπήγγειλεν τοῖς μετ’ αὐτοῦ γενομένοις πενθοῦσι καὶ κλαίουσιν
verses.transliteration: ekeinē poreutheisa apēngeilen tois met’ autou genomenois penthousi kai klaiousin
verses.literal: She went and told those who had been with Him who were mourning and weeping
verses.literalPt: Ela foi noticiá-lo aos que haviam andado com ele, os quais estavam em lamento e choro;

verses.original: κἀκεῖνοι ἀκούσαντες ὅτι ζῇ καὶ ἐθεάθη ὑπ’ αὐτῆς ἠπίστησαν
verses.transliteration: kakeinoi akousantes hoti zē kai etheathē hyp’ autēs ēpistēsan
verses.literal: And when they heard that Jesus was alive and she had seen Him . . . . . . they did not believe it
verses.literalPt: estes, ouvindo dizer que Jesus estava vivo e que tinha sido visto por ela, não acreditaram.

verses.original: Μετὰ δὲ ταῦτα δυσὶν ἐξ αὐτῶν περιπατοῦσιν ἐφανερώθη ἐν ἑτέρᾳ μορφῇ πορευομένοις εἰς ἀγρόν
verses.transliteration: Meta de tauta dysin ex autōn peripatousin ephanerōthē en hetera morphē poreuomenois eis agron
verses.literal: After this Jesus appeared in a different form to two of them as they walked along in the country
verses.literalPt: Depois disso, manifestou-se sob outra forma a dois deles que iam a caminho para o campo.

verses.original: κἀκεῖνοι ἀπελθόντες ἀπήγγειλαν τοῖς λοιποῖς οὐδὲ ἐκείνοις ἐπίστευσαν
verses.transliteration: kakeinoi apelthontes apēngeilan tois loipois oude ekeinois episteusan
verses.literal: And they went back and reported it to the rest but they did not believe them either
verses.literalPt: Eles foram anunciá-lo aos mais, mas nem a estes deram crédito.

verses.original: Ὕστερον δὲ ἀνακειμένοις αὐτοῖς τοῖς ἕνδεκα ἐφανερώθη καὶ ὠνείδισεν τὴν ἀπιστίαν αὐτῶν καὶ σκληροκαρδίαν ὅτι τοῖς θεασαμένοις αὐτὸν ἐγηγερμένον οὐκ ἐπίστευσαν
verses.transliteration: Hysteron de anakeimenois autois tois hendeka ephanerōthē kai ōneidisen tēn apistian autōn kai sklērokardian hoti tois theasamenois auton egēgermenon ouk episteusan
verses.literal: Later as they were eating Jesus appeared to the Eleven and rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart because they did not believe those who had seen Him after He had risen
verses.literalPt: Por último, manifestou-se aos onze, quando estavam à mesa, e censurou-lhes a incredulidade e dureza de coração, porque não deram crédito aos que o tinham visto depois de ressuscitado.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Πορευθέντες εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἅπαντα κηρύξατε τὸ εὐαγγέλιον πάσῃ τῇ κτίσει
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen autois Poreuthentes eis ton kosmon hapanta kēryxate to euangelion pasē tē ktisei
verses.literal: And He said to them Go into all the world and preach the gospel to every creature
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhes: Ide por todo o mundo e pregai o evangelho a toda a criatura.

verses.original: ὁ πιστεύσας καὶ βαπτισθεὶς σωθήσεται ὁ δὲ ἀπιστήσας κατακριθήσεται
verses.transliteration: ho pisteusas kai baptistheis sōthēsetai ho de apistēsas katakrithēsetai
verses.literal: Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved but whoever does not believe will be condemned
verses.literalPt: O que crer e for batizado será salvo; mas o que não crer será condenado.

verses.original: σημεῖα δὲ τοῖς πιστεύσασιν ταῦτα παρακολουθήσει ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου δαιμόνια ἐκβαλοῦσιν γλώσσαις λαλήσουσιν καιναῖς
verses.transliteration: sēmeia de tois pisteusasin tauta parakolouthēsei en tō onomati mou daimonia ekbalousin glōssais lalēsousin kainais
verses.literal: And these signs will accompany those who believe In My name they will drive out demons they will speak in new tongues
verses.literalPt: Estes sinais hão de acompanhar aqueles que creem: em meu nome, expelirão demônios; falarão outras línguas;

verses.original: και ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν ὄφεις ἀροῦσιν κἂν θανάσιμόν τι πίωσιν οὐ μὴ αὐτοὺς βλάψῃ ἐπὶ ἀρρώστους χεῖρας ἐπιθήσουσιν καὶ καλῶς ἕξουσιν
verses.transliteration: kai en tais chersin opheis arousin kan thanasimon ti piōsin ou mē autous blapsē epi arrōstous cheiras epithēsousin kai kalōs hexousin
verses.literal: they will pick up snakes with their hands and if they drink any deadly poison it will not harm them they will lay their hands on the sick and they will be made well
verses.literalPt: pegarão em serpentes; e, se beberem qualquer coisa mortífera, não lhes fará mal algum; porão as mãos sobre os enfermos e os curarão.

verses.original: Ὁ μὲν οὖν Κύριος Ἰησοῦς μετὰ τὸ λαλῆσαι αὐτοῖς ἀνελήμφθη εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἐκ δεξιῶν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ho men oun Kyrios Iēsous meta to lalēsai autois anelēmphthē eis ton ouranon kai ekathisen ek dexiōn tou Theou
verses.literal: After the Lord Jesus had spoken to them He was taken up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God
verses.literalPt: Assim, pois, o Senhor Jesus, depois de lhes ter falado, foi recebido no céu e sentou-se à destra de Deus.

verses.original: ἐκεῖνοι δὲ ἐξελθόντες ἐκήρυξαν πανταχοῦ τοῦ Κυρίου συνεργοῦντος καὶ τὸν λόγον βεβαιοῦντος διὰ τῶν ἐπακολουθούντων σημείων
verses.transliteration: ekeinoi de exelthontes ekēryxan pantachou tou Kyriou synergountos kai ton logon bebaiountos dia tōn epakolouthountōn sēmeiōn
verses.literal: And they went out and preached everywhere and the Lord worked through them confirming His word by the signs that accompanied it
verses.literalPt: Eles partiram e pregaram em toda a parte, cooperando com eles o Senhor e confirmando a palavra pelos milagres que a acompanhavam.]
